author: Thomas à Kempis
title: Of four things which bring great peace

notes.text: (1) Psalm lxxi. 12. (2) Isaiah xlv. 2. (3) Psalm cxxii. 7. (4) Psalm xliii. 3.

verses.text: “My Son, now will I teach thee the way of peace and of true liberty.”
verses.modernizedText: “My Son, now I will teach you the way of peace and of true liberty.”

verses.text: Do, O my Lord, as Thou sayest, for this is pleasing unto me to hear.
verses.modernizedText: Do so, O my Lord, as You say, for this is pleasing to me to hear.

verses.text: “Strive, My Son, to do another’s will rather than thine own.
verses.modernizedText: “Strive, My Son, to do another’s will rather than your own.

verses.text: Choose always to have less rather than more.
verses.modernizedText: Choose always to have less rather than more.

verses.text: Seek always after the lowest place, and to be subject to all.
verses.modernizedText: Seek always the lowest place, and to be subject to all.

verses.text: Wish always and pray that the will of God be fulfilled in thee.
verses.modernizedText: Wish always and pray that the will of God be fulfilled in you.

verses.text: Behold, such a man as this entereth into the inheritance of peace and quietness.”
verses.modernizedText: Behold, such a man as this enters into the inheritance of peace and quietness.”

verses.text: O my Lord, this Thy short discourse hath in itself much of perfectness.
verses.modernizedText: O my Lord, this Your short discourse has in itself much of perfectness.

verses.text: It is short in words but full of meaning, and abundant in fruit.
verses.modernizedText: It is short in words but full of meaning, and abundant in fruit.

verses.text: For if it were possible that I should fully keep it, disturbance would not so easily arise within me.
verses.modernizedText: For if it were possible that I should fully keep it, disturbance would not so easily arise within me.

verses.text: For as often as I feel myself disquieted and weighed down, I find myself to have gone back from this teaching.
verses.modernizedText: For as often as I feel myself disquieted and weighed down, I find myself to have gone back from this teaching.

verses.text: But Thou, Who art Almighty, and always lovest progress in the soul, vouchsafe more grace, that I may be enabled to fulfil Thy exhortation, and work out my salvation.
verses.modernizedText: But You, who are Almighty, and always love progress in the soul, be pleased to give more grace, that I may be enabled to fulfill Your exhortation, and work out my salvation.

verses.text: A PRAYER AGAINST EVIL THOUGHTS
verses.modernizedText: A PRAYER AGAINST EVIL THOUGHTS

verses.text: O Lord my God, be not Thou far from me, my God, haste Thee to help me,(1) for many thoughts and great fears have risen up against me, afflicting my soul.
verses.modernizedText: O Lord my God, do not be far from me; my God, hurry to help me,(1) for many thoughts and great fears have risen up against me, afflicting my soul.

verses.text: How shall I pass through them unhurt? how shall I break through them?
verses.modernizedText: How shall I pass through them unhurt? How shall I break through them?

verses.text: “I,” saith He, “will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight.”(2) I will open the prison doors, and reveal to thee the secret places.
verses.modernizedText: “I,” He says, “will go before you, and make the crooked places straight.”(2) I will open the prison doors, and reveal to you the secret places.

verses.text: Do, Lord, as Thou sayest; and let all evil thoughts fly away before Thy face.
verses.modernizedText: Do, Lord, as You say; and let all evil thoughts fly away before Your face.

verses.text: This is my hope and my only comfort, to fly unto Thee in all tribulation, to hope in Thee, to call upon Thee from my heart and patiently wait for Thy loving kindness.
verses.modernizedText: This is my hope and my only comfort, to fly to You in all tribulation, to hope in You, to call upon You from my heart and patiently wait for Your loving kindness.

verses.text: A PRAYER FOR ENLIGHTENMENT OF THE MIND
verses.modernizedText: A PRAYER FOR ENLIGHTENMENT OF THE MIND

verses.text: Enlighten me, Blessed Jesus, with the brightness of Thy inner light, and cast forth all darkness from the habitation of my heart.
verses.modernizedText: Enlighten me, Blessed Jesus, with the brightness of Your inner light, and cast forth all darkness from the habitation of my heart.

verses.text: Restrain my many wandering thoughts, and carry away the temptations which strive to do me hurt.
verses.modernizedText: Restrain my many wandering thoughts, and carry away the temptations which strive to do me hurt.

verses.text: Fight Thou mightily for me, and drive forth the evil beasts, so call I alluring lusts, that peace may be within Thy walls and plenteousness of praise within Thy palaces,(3) even in my pure conscience.
verses.modernizedText: Fight mightily for me, and drive forth the evil beasts, as I call alluring lusts, that peace may be within Your walls and abundance of praise within Your palaces,(3) even in my pure conscience.

verses.text: Command Thou the winds and the storms, say unto the sea, “Be still,” say unto the stormy wind, “Hold thy peace,” so shall there be a great calm.
verses.modernizedText: Command the winds and the storms, say to the sea, “Be still,” say to the stormy wind, “Be silent,” so there will be a great calm.

verses.text: Oh send forth Thy light and Thy truth,(4) that they may shine upon the earth; for I am but earth without form and void until Thou give me light.
verses.modernizedText: Oh send forth Your light and Your truth,(4) that they may shine upon the earth; for I am but earth without form and void until You give me light.

verses.text: Pour forth Thy grace from above; water my heart with the dew of heaven; give the waters of devotion to water the face of the earth, and cause it to bring forth good and perfect fruit.
verses.modernizedText: Pour forth Your grace from above; water my heart with the dew of heaven; give the waters of devotion to water the face of the earth, and cause it to bring forth good and perfect fruit.

verses.text: Lift up my mind which is oppressed with the weight of sins, and raise my whole desire to heavenly things; that having tasted the sweetness of the happiness which is from above, it may take no pleasure in thinking of things of earth.
verses.modernizedText: Lift up my mind which is oppressed with the weight of sins, and raise my whole desire to heavenly things; that having tasted the sweetness of the happiness which is from above, it may take no pleasure in thinking of things of earth.

verses.text: Draw me and deliver me from every unstable comfort of creatures, for no created thing is able to satisfy my desire and to give me comfort.
verses.modernizedText: Draw me and deliver me from every unstable comfort of creatures, for no created thing is able to satisfy my desire and to give me comfort.

verses.text: Join me to Thyself by the inseparable bond of love, for Thou alone art sufficient to him that loveth Thee, and without Thee all things are vain toys.
verses.modernizedText: Join me to Yourself by the inseparable bond of love, for You alone are sufficient to him who loves You, and without You all things are vain toys.
